title: Ancient Mural of Green Tara
description: A beautifully preserved mural depicting Green Tara, the female Buddha of compassion, painted in traditional mineral pigments.
significance: Represents the compassionate aspect of enlightenment and showcases traditional Sikkimese Buddhist art.

title: Kangyur Manuscript
description: A complete collection of the Kangyur, the translated words of the Buddha, preserved in palm-leaf format.
significance: Key scripture forming the foundation of Buddhist philosophy and teachings in Sikkim.

title: Wooden Prayer Wheel
description: An intricately carved prayer wheel with copper inscriptions, used during daily rituals.
significance: Symbolizes continuous recitation of mantras and spreading blessings.

title: Historical Photograph of Sanga Choeling
description: Rare early photograph showing the original structure of Sanga Choeling Monastery before renovations.
significance: Provides rare insight into Sikkimese monastery architecture in the early 20th century.

title: Wheel of Life (Bhavachakra)
description: A traditional depiction of samsara showing realms of existence and dependent origination.
significance: Educational mural used for teaching the path out of cyclic existence.

title: Young Monks in Ritual Practice
description: Photograph capturing novice monks engaged in daily chanting at the main courtyard.
significance: Documents living traditions and training of monks in Sikkim.

title: Ancient Mural of Green Tara
description: Mural painting traditionally executed with mineral pigments depicting Green Tara.
significance: Illustrates compassion and classical Himalayan mural style.

title: Historical Photograph of Sanga Choeling
description: Early photograph documenting the monastery's older architectural form.
significance: Valuable record for conservation and study.

title: Kangyur Manuscript
description: Traditional Buddhist scripture volume from the Kangyur collection.
material: Palm-leaf or paper with wooden covers
significance: Central canonical text of Tibetan Buddhism.

title: Wheel of Life (Bhavachakra)
description: Iconographic depiction of samsara with six realms and dependent origination.
significance: Pedagogical mural used in monastic teaching.

description: Carved wooden prayer wheel used in daily rituals.
